text: Haruffa. A nan za mu koyi haruffan Turanci.
en: Letters. Here we learn the English letters.

text: Nemo hoto. Za a faɗi sunan abu, sannan a danna hotonsa.

text: Rubutu. A nan za mu koyi rubuta kalmomin Turanci, harafi-harafi.
en: Writing. Here we learn to write English words, letter by letter.

text: Ga dukkan haruffa. Mu koyi su rukuni-rukuni.
en: Here are all the letters. Let's learn them group by group.

text: Dabbobi. Wannan darasi ne game da dabbobi iri-iri da suke rayuwa a kewayenmu.
en: Animals. This lesson is about the different animals that live around us.

text: Jiki. Wannan darasi ne game da sassa daban-daban na jikin mutum.
en: The body. This lesson is about the different parts of the human body.

text: Abinci. Wannan darasi ne game da abinci iri-iri da muke ci a kullum.
en: Food. This lesson is about the different foods we eat every day.

text: Kayan gida. Wannan darasi ne game da kayayyakin da ake amfani da su a gida.
en: Household things. This lesson is about the things used at home.

text: Yanayi. Wannan darasi ne game da abubuwan da ke cikin yanayi da muhalli.
en: Nature. This lesson is about the things in nature and our surroundings.

text: Motoci. Wannan darasi ne game da motoci da abubuwan hawa daban-daban.
en: Vehicles. This lesson is about cars and the different things we ride.

text: Yanzu za mu ga hotunan dabbobi. Za mu koyi sunayensu da Turanci.
en: Now we'll see pictures of animals. We'll learn their names in English.

text: Yanzu za mu ga hotunan sassan jiki. Za mu koyi sunayensu da Turanci.
en: Now we'll see pictures of body parts. We'll learn their names in English.

text: Yanzu za mu ga hotunan abinci. Za mu koyi sunayensu da Turanci.
en: Now we'll see pictures of food. We'll learn their names in English.

text: Yanzu za mu ga hotunan kayan gida. Za mu koyi sunayensu da Turanci.
en: Now we'll see pictures of household things. We'll learn their names in English.

text: Yanzu za mu ga hotunan abubuwan yanayi. Za mu koyi sunayensu da Turanci.
en: Now we'll see pictures of things in nature. We'll learn their names in English.

text: Yanzu za mu koyi ƙirga. Za a nuna yatsun hannu. A ƙirga yatsun da aka ɗaga, sannan a faɗi lambar da Turanci.
en: Now we'll learn to count. Fingers will be shown. Count the fingers that are up, then say the number in English.

text: Yanzu za mu ga hotunan motoci. Za mu koyi sunayensu da Turanci.
en: Now we'll see pictures of vehicles. We'll learn their names in English.

text: Madalla!
en: Well done!

en: No, not that one. Listen again, try again.

text.f: Madalla! Yanzu kin iya karatu!

en: Well done! Now you can read!

text: Ga kalma. Za mu karanta wannan kalma tare. Harafi, harafi.
en: Here is a word. We'll read this word together. Letter by letter.

text: Yanzu, a karanta kalmar gaba ɗaya, da babbar murya.
en: Now read the whole word, out loud.

text.f: Ki saurara, wannan shi ne

en: Listen, this is

en: No, try again.

text: Yanzu, za mu gauraya su.
en: Now we'll mix them up.

text.any: Yanzu, ka rubuta shi da Turanci. Akwai hanyoyi biyu.
text.f: Yanzu, ki rubuta shi da Turanci. Akwai hanyoyi biyu.

en: Now write it in English. There are two ways.

text: Danna ko a faɗi harafi na farko.
en: Tap or say the first letter.

text: Danna ko a faɗi harafi na biyu.
en: Tap or say the second letter.

text: Danna ko a faɗi harafi na uku.
en: Tap or say the third letter.

text: Danna ko a faɗi harafi na huɗu.
en: Tap or say the fourth letter.

text: Danna ko a faɗi harafi na biyar.
en: Tap or say the fifth letter.

text: Danna ko a faɗi harafi na shida.
en: Tap or say the sixth letter.

text: Danna ko a faɗi harafi na bakwai.
en: Tap or say the seventh letter.

text: Danna ko a faɗi harafi na takwas.
en: Tap or say the eighth letter.

text: Danna ko a faɗi harafi na tara.
en: Tap or say the ninth letter.

text.any: Ka danna Laila, ka faɗi harafin.
text.f: Ki danna Laila, ki faɗi harafin.

en: Press Laila and say the letter.

text.any: Ko kuma ka danna kowane harafi.
text.f: Ko kuma ki danna kowane harafi.

en: Or tap any letter.

text.f: Madalla! Kin gama wannan rukuni.

en: Well done! You've finished this group.

text: Ga darussa dabam-dabam. Danna kowane hoto don sanin abin da ke cikinsa.
en: Here are the different lessons. Tap any picture to find out what's in it.

text.f: Ki rubuta shi, harafi-harafi.

en: Write it, letter by letter.

text: Yanzu, jarrabawa! A rubuta kowanne, harafi-harafi.
en: Now, a test! Write each one, letter by letter.

en: Press Laila to start.

text: Sannu! Idan ke mace ce, danna fari. Idan kai namiji ne, danna ja.

text.f: Madalla! Kin riga kin ƙware haruffa duka!

en: Well done! Now you know all the letters.

text: Abubuwa. A nan za mu koyi sunayen abubuwa da Turanci, da hotuna.
en: Things. Here we learn the names of things in English, with pictures.

text.m: Madalla! Yanzu kaa iya haruffa da kalmomi duka.
text.f: Madalla! Yanzu kin iya haruffa da kalmomi duka.

en: Well done! Now you know all the letters and words.

text.m: Akwai wani a kusa da kai. Don Allah, ka zauna kai kaɗai a gaban kyamara.
text.f: Akwai wani a kusa da ke. Don Allah, ki zauna ke kaɗai a gaban kyamara.

en: There is someone next to you. Please sit alone in front of the camera.

text.m: Don komawa baya, ka danna wannan ƙofa.
text.f: Don komawa baya, ki danna wannan ƙofa.

en: Welcome back!

text: Ayyuka. Wannan darasi ne game da abubuwan da muke yi a kullum. Kamar ci, sha, gudu da wasa.
en: Actions. This lesson is about the things we do every day. Like eating, drinking, running and playing.

text: Tufafi. Wannan darasi ne game da tufafin da muke sawa a jiki.
en: Clothing. This lesson is about the clothes we wear.

text: Mutane. Wannan darasi ne game da mutanen da ke kewaye da mu. Mama, baba, yara da malamai.
en: People. This lesson is about the people around us. Mum, dad, children and teachers.

text: Makaranta. Wannan darasi ne game da kayan makaranta da muke amfani da su.
en: School. This lesson is about the things we use at school.

text: Yanzu za mu ga hotunan ayyuka. Za mu koyi sunayensu da Turanci.
en: Now we'll see pictures of actions. We'll learn their names in English.

text: Yanzu za mu ga hotunan tufafi. Za mu koyi sunayensu da Turanci.
en: Now we'll see pictures of clothes. We'll learn their names in English.

text: Yanzu za mu ga hotunan mutane. Za mu koyi sunayensu da Turanci.
en: Now we'll see pictures of people. We'll learn their names in English.

text: Yanzu za mu ga hotunan kayan makaranta. Za mu koyi sunayensu da Turanci.
en: Now we'll see pictures of school things. We'll learn their names in English.

text.m: Matso kusa da kyamara.
text.f: Matso kusa da kyamara.

en: Come closer to the camera.

text.m: Don sa ke ji, ka danna wannan kunne.
text.f: Don sa ke ji, ki danna wannan kunne.

en: To hear it again, press this ear.

text.m: Za mu ɗauki bidiyonka kana faɗin sunanka. Misali, idan sunanka Musa ne, ka ce: Sunana Musa. Danna kan Laila idan ka shirya.
text.f: Za mu ɗauki bidiyonki kina faɗin sunanki. Misali, idan sunanki Aisha ne, ki ce: Sunana Aisha. Danna kan Laila idan kin shirya.

en: We'll take a video of you saying your name. For example, if your name is Musa, say: My name is Musa. Tap Laila when you're ready.

text.m: Yanzu, ka danna kan Laila mu fara.
text.f: Yanzu, ki danna kan Laila mu fara.

en: Now press Laila and we'll start.

text: Karatu. A nan za mu karanta kalmomi, harafi bayan harafi, sannan gaba ɗaya.
en: Reading. Here we read words, letter by letter, then all at once.

text: Yanzu, za mu karanta sunayen waɗannan abubuwa da Turanci.
en: Now we'll read the names of these things in English.

text.m: Yanzu za mu yi ƙaramin jarrabawa a kan kalmomin da kaa koyaa. Za a nuna maka kalma, sai ka karanta ta gaba ɗaya.
text.f: Yanzu za mu yi ƙaramin jarrabawa a kan kalmomin da kika koyaa. Za a nuna miki kalma, sai ki karanta ta gaba ɗaya.

en: Now we'll do a small test on the words you learned. A word will be shown, and you read it whole.

text: Kalmomi gajeru. A nan za mu karanta kalmomi gajeru, masu haruffa uku.
en: Short words. Here we read short, three-letter words.

text: Kalmomi matsakaita. A nan za mu karanta kalmomi masu haruffa huɗu da biyar.
en: Medium words. Here we read four- and five-letter words.

text: Kalmomi dogaye. A nan za mu karanta kalmomi dogaye.
en: Long words. Here we read long words.

text: Lambobi. A nan za mu karanta sunayen lambobi da Turanci.
en: Numbers. Here we read the names of numbers in English.

text.m: Yanzu za mu yi ƙaramin jarrabawa, don mu tabbata kaa gane haruffan da kaa koyaa.
text.f: Yanzu za mu yi ƙaramin jarrabawa, don mu tabbata kin gane haruffan da kika koyaa.

en: Now we'll do a small test, to make sure you understood the letters you learned.

text.m: Babbar jarrabawa. Ka faɗi haruffa duka, ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
text.f: Babbar jarrabawa. Ki faɗi haruffa duka, ɗaya bayan ɗaya.

en: The big test. Say all the letters, one after another.

text.m: Jarrabawa ta ƙarshe. Za a nuna haruffa a gauraye, ka faɗe su duka.
text.f: Jarrabawa ta ƙarshe. Za a nuna haruffa a gauraye, ki faɗe su duka.

en: The last test. The letters will be shown mixed up; say them all.

text.m: Ga haruffa huɗu. Ka saurara, ka kalla.
text.f: Ga haruffa huɗu. Ki saurara, ki kalla.

en: Here are four letters. Listen and look.

text.m: Yanzu za ka ga sababbin haruffa biyu don koyo. Wannan sabon mataki ne, mai muhimmanci ƙwarai.
text.f: Yanzu za ki ga sababbin haruffa biyu don koyo. Wannan sabon mataki ne, mai muhimmanci ƙwarai.

en: Now you'll see two new letters to learn. This is a new stage, a very important one.

text.m: Yanzu za ka ga sababbin haruffa huɗu don koyo. Wannan sabon mataki ne, mai muhimmanci ƙwarai.
text.f: Yanzu za ki ga sababbin haruffa huɗu don koyo. Wannan sabon mataki ne, mai muhimmanci ƙwarai.

en: Now you'll see four new letters to learn. This is a new stage, a very important one.

text.m: Yanzu, kai ka faɗi shi da kanka.
text.f: Yanzu, ke ki faɗi shi da kanki.

en: Now you say it yourself.

text.m: Sunana Laila. Ni ce abokiyar koyonka. Yanzu, ka danna kaina mu fara.
text.f: Sunana Laila. Ni ce abokiyar koyonki. Yanzu, ki danna kaina mu fara.

en: My name is Laila. I'm your learning friend. Now press my head and we'll start.

text: Za a ƙare zaman. Idan an gama, a danna Laila. In ba haka ba, a danna baƙin allo.
en: The session will end. If you are done, press Laila. If not, press the black slate.

text.m: Nemi wuri mai haske.
text.f: Nemi wuri mai haske.

en: Find a brighter spot.

text: Don Allah a ɗan jira. Ana shirya komai.
en: Please wait a little. Everything is getting ready.

text.m: Duba kyamara.
text.f: Duba kyamara.

en: Look at the camera.

text: Yanzu za mu koyi manyan lambobi: talatin, arba'in, hamsin, har ɗari.

text: Ba a ba da izini ba. A sake gwadawa, a danna 'Allow'.
en: Permission was not given. Try again and tap 'Allow'.

text.m: Yanzu mu sa ke gwadawa, da sababbi. Ka saurara da kyau.
text.f: Yanzu mu sa ke gwadawa, da sababbi. Ki saurara da kyau.

en: Now let's play again, with new ones. Listen carefully.

text.m: Hotuna huɗu. Za a nuna maka hotuna huɗu, a faɗi sunan ɗaya da Turanci, sai ka danna shi.
text.f: Hotuna huɗu. Za a nuna miki hotuna huɗu, a faɗi sunan ɗaya da Turanci, sai ki danna shi.

en: Four pictures. You'll see four pictures, one will be named in English, and you tap it.

text.m: Lambobi. Za a faɗi lamba da Turanci, sai ka danna alamarta.
text.f: Lambobi. Za a faɗi lamba da Turanci, sai ki danna alamarta.

en: Numbers. A number will be said in English, and you tap its sign.

text: Danna alamar lambar da aka faɗa.
en: Tap the sign of the number that was said.

text.m: A nan za mu koyi rubuta sunayen abubuwa da Turanci, harafi-harafi. Za a nuna maka hoto, sai ka rubuta sunansa.
text.f: A nan za mu koyi rubuta sunayen abubuwa da Turanci, harafi-harafi. Za a nuna miki hoto, sai ki rubuta sunansa.

en: Here we learn to write the names of things in English, letter by letter. A picture will be shown, and you write its name.

text.m: Yanzu kai. Ka zaɓi darasi.
text.f: Yanzu ke. Ki zaɓi darasi.

en: Your turn. Pick a lesson.

text.m: Sannu da aiki!
text.f: Kin iyaa sosai!

en: Well done!

text: Haruffa uku. A nan za mu rubuta kalmomi masu haruffa uku, harafi-harafi.
en: Three letters. Here we write three-letter words, letter by letter.

text: Haruffa huɗu. A nan za mu rubuta kalmomi masu haruffa huɗu, harafi-harafi.
en: Four letters. Here we write four-letter words, letter by letter.

text: Haruffa biyar. A nan za mu rubuta kalmomi masu haruffa biyar, harafi-harafi.
en: Five letters. Here we write five-letter words, letter by letter.

text: Kalmomi dogaye. A nan za mu rubuta kalmomi dogaye, harafi-harafi.
en: Long words. Here we write long words, letter by letter.

text: Lambobi. A nan za mu rubuta sunayen lambobi da Turanci, harafi-harafi.
en: Numbers. Here we write the names of numbers in English, letter by letter.

text.m: Ba na ganin ka sosai. Don Allah, mu sake gwadawa.
text.f: Ba na ganin ki sosai. Don Allah, mu sake gwadawa.

en: I can't see you well. Please, let's try again.

text.m: Ban ji sunan ka sosai ba. Don Allah, mu sake gwadawa.
text.f: Ban ji sunan ki sosai ba. Don Allah, mu sake gwadawa.

en: I couldn't hear you say your name. Please, let's try again.

text.m: Ka danna kan Laila don sake gwadawa.
text.f: Ki danna kan Laila don sake gwadawa.

en: Click Laila to try again.
said_when: retry gate, while Laila is lit

text.m: Ko kuma ka danna wannan ƙofa don komawa farko.
text.f: Ko kuma ki danna wannan ƙofa don komawa farko.

en: Or click this door to go back and start again.
said_when: retry gate, while the door is lit

text: Sannu,
en: Hello,

text.m: Ka faɗi shi yanzu.
text.f: Ki faɗi shi yanzu.

en: Say it now.

text: Harafi na farko shi ne:
en: The first letter is:

text: Harafi na biyu shi ne:
en: The second letter is:

text: Harafi na uku shi ne:
en: The third letter is:

text: Harafi na huɗu shi ne:
en: The fourth letter is:

text: Harafi na biyar shi ne:
en: The fifth letter is:

text: Harafi na shida shi ne:
en: The sixth letter is:

text: Harafi na bakwai shi ne:
en: The seventh letter is:

text: Harafi na takwas shi ne:
en: The eighth letter is:

text: Harafi na tara shi ne:
en: The ninth letter is:

text: A danna shi.
en: Tap it.

text: Ana rubuta shi haka:
en: It is written like this:

text.m: Tsaya cak.
text.f: Tsaya cak.

en: Hold still.

text: To. Mu koyi wannan rukuni tukuna.
en: Alright. Let's learn this group first.
note: the "do you know the alphabet?" gate is gone: the lesson teaches straight away (Sani 2026-09-24)

text: Barka da zuwa!
en: Welcome!

text.m: Misali! Ka kalla, ka saurara yadda ake yi.
text.f: Misali! Ki kalla, ki saurara yadda ake yi.

en: Example! Watch and listen to how it's done.

text.m: Ni zan karanta haruffan, ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Ka saurara.
text.f: Ni zan karanta haruffan, ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Ki saurara.

en: I will read the letters, one by one. Listen.
said_when: the reading sample, before Laila reads the letters (Sani 15 Sep: make it clear who reads, then what the child will say)

text: Ga abin da zan faɗa:
en: Here is what I'll say:

text.m: Yanzu kai. Ka gwada.
text.f: Yanzu ke. Ki gwada.

en: Your turn. Try it.

text.m: Sunana Laila. Ni ce abokiyar koyonka.
text.f: Sunana Laila. Ni ce abokiyar koyonki.

en: My name is Laila. I am your learning friend.
said_when: first day, after the greeting

text: Tare, za mu koyi Turanci.
en: Together we are going to learn English.

text: Ina da darussa masu kyau.
en: I have amazing lessons.

text: Za mu koyi haruffan Turanci.
en: We will learn the English alphabet.

text: Za mu koyi karatu da rubutu da Turanci.
en: We will learn to read and write in English.

text: Za mu koyi ƙirga.
en: We will learn to count.

text: Za mu koyi sunayen abubuwa kamar dabbobi da abinci da Turanci.
en: We will learn the names of things like animals and foods, in English.

text: Da sauran abubuwa masu ban sha'awa da yawa.
en: And many other amazing things.

text.m: Za ka iya magana da ni. Zan kasance tare da kai.
text.f: Za ki iya magana da ni. Zan kasance tare da ke.

en: You will be able to speak to me and I will be with you.

text.m: Na yi farin cikin ganinka.
text.f: Na yi farin cikin ganinki.

en: I am happy to see you.

text: Yanzu, mu ci gaba daga inda muka tsaya.
en: Now let us continue from where we stopped.

text.m: Ga abin da za ka yi don ka faɗa da Turanci. Za ka danna Laila, sannan ka ce:
text.f: Ga abin da za ki yi don ki faɗa da Turanci. Za ki danna Laila, sannan ki ce:

en: Here is what you will do to say it in English. You will press Laila, then you will say:
said_when: the example, before the thing to say

text.m: Ga abin da za ka yi don ka karanta da Turanci. Za ka danna Laila, sannan ka karanta kalmar:
text.f: Ga abin da za ki yi don ki karanta da Turanci. Za ki danna Laila, sannan ki karanta kalmar:

en: Here is what you will do to read it in English. You will press Laila, then you will read the word:

text.m: Ga abin da za ka yi don ka rubuta da Turanci. Za ka danna Laila, sannan ka faɗi haruffan:
text.f: Ga abin da za ki yi don ki rubuta da Turanci. Za ki danna Laila, sannan ki faɗi haruffan:

en: Here is what you will do to write it in English. You will press Laila, then you will say the letters:

text.m: Ga abin da za ka yi. Ka saurara, sannan ka danna hoton da aka faɗa.
text.f: Ga abin da za ki yi. Ki saurara, sannan ki danna hoton da aka faɗa.

en: Here is what you will do. Listen, then press the picture that was named.

text.m: Ga abin da za ka yi. Ka saurara, sannan ka danna alamar lambar da aka faɗa.
text.f: Ga abin da za ki yi. Ki saurara, sannan ki danna alamar lambar da aka faɗa.

en: Here is what you will do. Listen, then press the number that was named.

text.m: Yanzu, za a nuna maka hotuna huɗu. Ka saurara sunan da aka faɗa da Turanci, sannan ka danna shi.
text.f: Yanzu, za a nuna miki hotuna huɗu. Ki saurara sunan da aka faɗa da Turanci, sannan ki danna shi.

en: Now you will be shown four pictures. Listen for the name said in English, then press it.
said_when: the picture game, after its example

text.m: Yanzu, za a nuna maka alamomi. Ka saurara lambar da aka faɗa da Turanci, sannan ka danna ta.
text.f: Yanzu, za a nuna miki alamomi. Ki saurara lambar da aka faɗa da Turanci, sannan ki danna ta.

en: Now you will be shown numbers. Listen for the one said in English, then press it.
said_when: the number game, after its example

text: Za mu faɗi haruffan ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Akwai hanyoyi biyu.
en: We will say the letters one after another. There are two ways.
said_when: before the first letter

text: Ta farko, da murya.
en: The first, with your voice.
said_when: while Laila is spotlit

text: Ta biyu, da allo.
en: The second, with the board.
said_when: while the keyboard is spotlit

text: Harafi na farko, zan faɗa da murya.
en: The first letter, I will say with my voice.
said_when: she demonstrates the first letter

text: Harafi na biyu ma, zan faɗa da murya.
en: The second letter too, I will say with my voice.

text: Harafi na ƙarshe kuwa, zan danna shi a kan allo.
en: And the last letter, I will press it on the board.

text.m: Ga balan-balan masu haruffa. Ka danna balan-balan da yatsanka, sai ya fashe.
text.f: Ga balan-balan masu haruffa. Ki danna balan-balan da yatsanki, sai ya fashe.

en: Here are balloons with letters. Press a balloon with your finger and it bursts.

text: Madalla, mun gama wasan!
en: Well done, we've finished the game!

text.m: Ga misali. Zan fasa na farko:
text.f: Ga misali. Zan fasa na farko:

en: Here is an example. I'll pop the first one:
said_when: before Laila points at A and pops it; the letter itself is said next No demonstration and no naming of other letters in the game (Sani 12 Oct 15:18).

text.m: Yanzu kai.
text.f: Yanzu ke.

en: Now you.
said_when: after the example, and when a child stalls No demonstration and no naming of other letters in the game (Sani 12 Oct 15:18).

text.m: Ka fasa harafin bayan
text.f: Ki fasa harafin bayan

en: Pop the letter after
said_when: before each letter, followed by the letter just popped, in Nigerian English No demonstration and no naming of other letters in the game (Sani 12 Oct 15:18).

text.m: Ka nemo harafi na farko na Turanci, ka fasa shi. Sannan harafin bayan sa.
text.f: Ki nemo harafi na farko na Turanci, ki fasa shi. Sannan harafin bayan sa.

en: Find the first letter of English and pop it. Then the letter after it.
said_when: after the balloons are introduced 'bi da bi' dropped (Sani 12 Oct 15:18).

text.m: Ka fasa harafin farko:
text.f: Ki fasa harafin farko:

en: Pop the first letter:
said_when: Every 5 s while A is due, followed by app_en_A — A is the only letter she may name (Sani 12 Oct 15:18). Unreviewed: Claude draft.
review: unreviewed: Claude draft from Sani's English, 12 Oct

text.m: Ka fasa harafi na gaba.
text.f: Ki fasa harafi na gaba.

en: Pop the next letter.
said_when: Every 5 s after A until the right balloon goes; never names the letter (Sani 12 Oct 15:18). Unreviewed: Claude draft.
review: unreviewed: Claude draft from Sani's English, 12 Oct

text.m: Zan nuna maka kuma. Ka kula.
text.f: Zan nuna miki kuma. Ki kula.

en: I will show you again. Pay attention.
said_when: Third wrong answer in an example, just before Laila gives the answer herself.

text.m: Ba daidai ba ne, amma za ka koya.
text.f: Ba daidai ba ne, amma za ki koya.

en: That was not right, but you will learn.
said_when: After Laila has given the answer herself, instead of praise.

text.m: Kana da lokaci ka gama dukan haruffa, A zuwa Z.
text.f: Kina da lokaci ki gama dukan haruffa, A zuwa Z.

en: You have time to finish all the letters, A to Z.
said_when: The rules, once, before the child's own run.

text.m: In ka samu daidai, lokaci zai ƙaru. In ka kuskure, lokaci zai ragu.
text.f: In kin samu daidai, lokaci zai ƙaru. In kin kuskure, lokaci zai ragu.

en: Get it right and time goes up. Get it wrong and time goes down.
said_when: The rules, once, before the child's own run.

text.m: In lokaci ya ƙare, ba ka ci wasan ba. Sa'a!
text.f: In lokaci ya ƙare, ba ki ci wasan ba. Sa'a!

en: If the time runs out, you have not won. Good luck!
said_when: The last thing she says before the clock starts.

text: Lokaci ya ƙare. Mu koyi haruffa tukuna.
en: Time is up. Let us learn the letters first.
said_when: The clock reached zero; the child goes to Haruffa.

text.m: Ka san haruffa.
text.f: Kin san haruffa.

en: You know your letters.
said_when: Finished the whole alphabet inside the time.

text.m: Ka san dukan haruffa?
text.f: Kin san dukan haruffa?

en: Do you know all the letters?
said_when: The gate, before she names them. Replaced on the gate by s_gate_first / s_gate_yes / s_gate_no (12 Oct).

text: …har zuwa Z?
en: …all the way to Z?
said_when: After A B C D, to make the question the whole alphabet. Dropped from the gate (Sani 12 Oct 13:02).

text.m: In ka sani, ka danna Laila. In ba ka sani ba, ka danna allo.
text.f: In kin sani, ki danna Laila. In ba ki sani ba, ki danna allo.

en: If you know them, tap Laila. If you do not, tap the slate.
said_when: The two choices, named. Replaced on the gate by s_gate_first / s_gate_yes / s_gate_no (12 Oct).

text.m: Kada ka damu. Mu koyi su tukuna.
text.f: Kada ki damu. Mu koyi su tukuna.

en: Don't worry. Let us learn them first.
said_when: They tapped the slate; straight into Haruffa.

text: Za mu yi ɗan wasa.
en: We are going to play a little game.
said_when: The invitation, before the question. Replaced on the gate by s_gate_first / s_gate_yes / s_gate_no (12 Oct).

text.m: Muna so mu tabbatar cewa ka iya haruffan Turanci, kamar
text.f: Muna so mu tabbatar cewa kin iya haruffan Turanci, kamar

en: We want to make sure you know the English letters, like
said_when: Opens the gate; then A, B, C, D in her English letter clips. Wording per Sani 12 Oct 13:02.
review: Sani 12 Oct 13:02 wording

text.m: Idan ka sani, ka danna Laila mu fara.
text.f: Idan kin sani, ki danna Laila mu fara.

en: If you know them, tap Laila to begin.
said_when: The first choice, with the hand on Laila. Unreviewed: Claude draft from Sani's English (12 Oct).
review: unreviewed: Claude draft from Sani's English, 12 Oct

text.m: Idan baka sani ba, ba damuwa, za mu koye su tare. Ka danna baƙin allo don mu fara koyo.
text.f: Idan baki sani ba, ba damuwa, za mu koye su tare. Ki danna baƙin allo don mu fara koyo.

en: If you don't, no problem, we will learn them together. Tap the black slate to begin learning.
said_when: The second choice, with the hand on the slate. Unreviewed: Claude draft from Sani's English (12 Oct).
review: Sani 12 Oct 14:38: 'baka sani ba' (the voice read 'ba ka sani' and lost the last 'ba')

text.m: Ka iya faɗin haruffan Turanci ɗaya-ɗaya?
text.f: Kin iya faɗin haruffan Turanci ɗaya-ɗaya?

en: Can you say the English letters one by one?
said_when: First thing on the game: Na sani (Laila) or Ban sani ba (slate). Unreviewed: Claude draft.
review: unreviewed: Claude draft, games moved into the app 14 Oct

text.m: Ka san sunayen abubuwa da Turanci?
text.f: Kin san sunayen abubuwa da Turanci?

en: Do you know the names of things in English?
said_when: First thing on the game: Na sani (Laila) or Ban sani ba (slate). Unreviewed: Claude draft.
review: unreviewed: Claude draft, games moved into the app 14 Oct

text.m: Ka kama kifin da ke ɗauke da abin da na faɗa.
text.f: Ki kama kifin da ke ɗauke da abin da na faɗa.

en: Catch the fish carrying the thing I say.
said_when: After Na sani, before the 3-2-1; also the reminder after 10 s of quiet. Unreviewed: Claude draft.
review: unreviewed: Claude draft, games moved into the app 14 Oct

text.m: Ka iya faɗin sunayen abubuwa da Turanci?
text.f: Kin iya faɗin sunayen abubuwa da Turanci?

en: Can you say the names of things in English?
said_when: First thing on the game: Na sani (Laila) or Ban sani ba (slate). Unreviewed: Claude draft.
review: unreviewed: Claude draft, games moved into the app 14 Oct

text.m: Duba hoton nan. Ka danna Laila, ka faɗi sunansa da Turanci, sai in buga kalangu!
text.f: Duba hoton nan. Ki danna Laila, ki faɗi sunansa da Turanci, sai in buga kalangu!

en: Look at this picture. Tap Laila, say its name in English, and I will beat the drum!
said_when: After Na sani, before the 3-2-1; also the reminder after 10 s of quiet. Unreviewed: Claude draft.
review: unreviewed: Claude draft, games moved into the app 14 Oct

text.m: Za ka iya gane abu idan an faɗe shi da Turanci?
text.f: Za ki iya gane abu idan an faɗe shi da Turanci?

en: Can you find a thing when it is said in English?
said_when: First thing on the game: Na sani (Laila) or Ban sani ba (slate). Unreviewed: Claude draft.
review: unreviewed: Claude draft, games moved into the app 14 Oct

text.m: Masu saye sun zo! Ka ba kowa abin da ya roƙa da sauri.
text.f: Masu saye sun zo! Ki ba kowa abin da ya roƙa da sauri.

en: The shoppers are here! Quickly give each one what they ask for.
said_when: After Na sani, before the 3-2-1; also the reminder after 10 s of quiet. Unreviewed: Claude draft.
review: unreviewed: Claude draft, games moved into the app 14 Oct

text.m: Ka iya ƙirga da Turanci?
text.f: Kin iya ƙirga da Turanci?

en: Can you count in English?
said_when: First thing on the game: Na sani (Laila) or Ban sani ba (slate). Unreviewed: Claude draft.
review: unreviewed: Claude draft, games moved into the app 14 Oct

text.m: Ka iya karanta kalmomi da Turanci?
text.f: Kin iya karanta kalmomi da Turanci?

en: Can you read words in English?
said_when: First thing on the game: Na sani (Laila) or Ban sani ba (slate). Unreviewed: Claude draft.
review: unreviewed: Claude draft, games moved into the app 14 Oct

text.m: Ka karanta kalmar da ke cikin kowane kwale-kwale, sannan ka danna wadda ta dace da hoton.
text.f: Ki karanta kalmar da ke cikin kowane kwale-kwale, sannan ki danna wadda ta dace da hoton.

en: Read the word in each canoe, then tap the one that matches the picture.
said_when: After Na sani, before the 3-2-1; also the reminder after 10 s of quiet. Unreviewed: Claude draft.
review: unreviewed: Claude draft, games moved into the app 14 Oct

text.m: Ka iya rubuta kalmomi da Turanci?
text.f: Kin iya rubuta kalmomi da Turanci?

en: Can you spell words in English?
said_when: First thing on the game: Na sani (Laila) or Ban sani ba (slate). Unreviewed: Claude draft.
review: unreviewed: Claude draft, games moved into the app 14 Oct

text.m: Bari mu gina kalma da tukwane. Ka danna haruffa ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
text.f: Bari mu gina kalma da tukwane. Ki danna haruffa ɗaya bayan ɗaya.

en: Let's build a word with pots. Tap the letters one after another.
said_when: After Na sani, before the 3-2-1; also the reminder after 10 s of quiet. Unreviewed: Claude draft.
review: unreviewed: Claude draft, games moved into the app 14 Oct

text.m: Ka iya faɗin haruffan kalma ɗaya bayan ɗaya?
text.f: Kin iya faɗin haruffan kalma ɗaya bayan ɗaya?

en: Can you say the letters of a word one after another?
said_when: First thing on the game: Na sani (Laila) or Ban sani ba (slate). Unreviewed: Claude draft.
review: unreviewed: Claude draft, games moved into the app 14 Oct

text.m: Mu gina gida kafin lokaci ya ƙare! Ka danna Laila, ka faɗi haruffan kalmar ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Kowane harafi bulo ne.
text.f: Mu gina gida kafin lokaci ya ƙare! Ki danna Laila, ki faɗi haruffan kalmar ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Kowane harafi bulo ne.

en: Let's build the house before time runs out! Tap Laila and say the word's letters one by one. Every letter is a brick.
said_when: After Na sani, before the 3-2-1; also the reminder after 10 s of quiet. Unreviewed: Claude draft.
review: unreviewed: Claude draft, games moved into the app 14 Oct

text: Ba komai! Mu fara koyo tare. Danna Laila don a ci gaba.
en: No problem! Let's start learning together. Tap Laila to continue.
said_when: After Ban sani ba. Unreviewed: Claude draft.
review: unreviewed: Claude draft, games moved into the app 14 Oct

text: Danna Laila don a ci gaba.
en: Tap Laila to continue.
said_when: After the score, following app_kudos. Unreviewed: Claude draft.
review: unreviewed: Claude draft, games moved into the app 14 Oct

text.m: Ka faɗi harafin da ke kan tutar mahayin doki, sai ya gaida sarki!
text.f: Ki faɗi harafin da ke kan tutar mahayin doki, sai ya gaida sarki!

en: Say the letter on the horseman's banner, and he will greet the emir!
said_when: After Na sani, before the 3-2-1; also the reminder after 10 s of quiet. Unreviewed: Claude draft.
review: unreviewed: Claude draft, Arewa games 16 Oct

text.m: Ga yadda wasan yake: mahayin doki zai zo da tuta mai harafi. Idan ya tsaya, ka faɗi harafin da ke kan tutarsa da babbar murya.
text.f: Ga yadda wasan yake: mahayin doki zai zo da tuta mai harafi. Idan ya tsaya, ki faɗi harafin da ke kan tutarsa da babbar murya.

en: Here is how the game works: a horseman comes with a flag with a letter on it. When he stops, say the letter on his flag out loud.
said_when: In the example, after Misali, as the first horseman rides in; Laila then listens by herself.
review: approved: Sani 24 Oct

text.m: Idan ka faɗi harafin daidai, Sarki zai yi farin ciki ya ɗaga masa hannu, masu gadi za su buɗe ƙofa, kuma mahayin zai shiga fada.
text.f: Idan kin faɗi harafin daidai, Sarki zai yi farin ciki ya ɗaga masa hannu, masu gadi za su buɗe ƙofa, kuma mahayin zai shiga fada.

en: If you say the letter right, the Sarki is happy and waves to him, the guards open the gate, and the horseman goes into the palace.
said_when: In the example, after the right answer: the emir waves and the rider rides into the palace.
review: approved: Sani 24 Oct

text.m: Idan ba ka faɗi daidai ba, Sarki ba zai ji daɗi ba, ƙofa za ta zauna a rufe, kuma mahayin zai koma baya.
text.f: Idan ba ki faɗi daidai ba, Sarki ba zai ji daɗi ba, ƙofa za ta zauna a rufe, kuma mahayin zai koma baya.

en: If you don't say it right, the Sarki is not pleased, the gate stays shut, and the horseman turns back.
said_when: In the example, after the wrong answer: the emir turns away and the rider rides back out.
review: approved: Sani 24 Oct

text.m: Idan ka shirya, ka danna Laila mu fara.
text.f: Idan kin shirya, ki danna Laila mu fara.

en: When you are ready, press Laila and we will start.
said_when: At the end of the example; the game starts when the child presses Laila.
review: approved: Sani 24 Oct

text.m: Ka faɗi sunan abin nan da Turanci, sai dillali ya sayar da shi!
